name: Plugsera Bulkrify – Bulk Editor for WooCommerce
author: plugsera

sections.description:
Managing many WooCommerce products can be time-consuming.

The default WooCommerce bulk editor is limited, and CSV-based solutions are risky and slow.

Bulkrify is a lightweight WooCommerce bulk editor plugin that lets you update product data directly from your dashboard — quickly and safely.

This free version focuses on essential bulk editing, while advanced workflows like spreadsheet editing and rollback are available in Bulkrify Pro.

🔹 What Bulkrify Free Does

Bulkrify Free allows you to:

  • Bulk edit product prices
  • Bulk edit stock quantity and stock status
  • Bulk edit SKU
  • Bulk edit product titles
  • Select and edit multiple products at once
  • Use a clean, modern interface
  • Edit products directly inside WooCommerce
  • Avoid CSV import/export risks
  • Keep all data on your own server (no external APIs)

This makes Bulkrify a practical alternative to the default WooCommerce bulk editor.

🔥 Bulkrify Pro – Advanced Bulk Editing (Optional)

Bulkrify Pro is built for store owners and managers who bulk edit frequently or handle large product catalogs.

Bulkrify Pro Features:

  • Excel-style spreadsheet editor for WooCommerce products
  • Fast keyboard-based editing workflow
  • Reliable rollback for bulk and spreadsheet edits
  • One-click rollback of previous bulk operations
  • Safer editing for variable products
  • Designed to prevent bulk-edit mistakes
  • Optimized for large WooCommerce stores
  • No CSV files required
  • No external services or tracking

📌 Note:
Rollback and spreadsheet features are available only in the Pro plugin.
The free version does not include rollback functionality.

⭐ Why Choose Bulkrify?

  • Built specifically for WooCommerce bulk editing
  • Faster and cleaner than the default bulk editor
  • No risky CSV workflows
  • Lightweight and performance-friendly
  • Honest free version with optional Pro upgrade
  • Designed for real store management needs

👥 Who Is Bulkrify For?

Bulkrify is ideal for:

  • WooCommerce store owners
  • Store managers handling many products
  • Agencies managing client stores
  • Anyone who needs faster bulk product updates

🎥 Pro Feature Walkthrough

A walkthrough video demonstrating Bulkrify Pro features is available on the plugin website.

The free version works independently and includes essential bulk editing features.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/plugsera-bulkrify-bulk-editor/, or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Bulkrify to start bulk editing products.
sections.faq:
Does the free version include rollback?

No. Rollback functionality is available only in Bulkrify Pro.

Is Bulkrify better than the default WooCommerce bulk editor?

Yes. Bulkrify provides a cleaner interface and supports more practical bulk editing workflows.

Does Bulkrify use CSV import or export?

No. Bulkrify edits products directly inside WooCommerce.

Is my data sent to external servers?

No. All operations run locally on your WordPress site.

Can Bulkrify handle large product catalogs?

Yes. Bulkrify Pro is optimized for large WooCommerce stores.
